prose: VentureBeat reports Strands Labs, AWS's experimental agent-development project, released Strands Decider 2B, a free open-source decision model fine-tuned from an Alibaba model and a competitor to TypeSafe's Jev. In the two weeks since Jev, developers have shipped a rush of decision models, many with downloadable weights. These models choose among predefined options instead of writing prose, part of making agents cheaper and faster.
highlights: Strands Decider 2B: free, open-source decision model
Decision models pick among predefined options
Many rivals released in two weeks
